verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same rewritings as for (9.17) and nothing else. The paper's |(u^{[j]},p^{[j]})|_m is the max of Cartesian space–time derivatives through order m of the pair; Lean bounds the sum of ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k‖ of velocity and pressure for every k ≤ m, which is between the max and twice the max. u^{[J]}, p^{[J]} are the literal partial sums (uncutVelocity / uncutPrefix over Finset.range (J+1), before summation cutoffs), as in the paper. K_m = paperJetLoss B N0 m carries no stage index, matching 'with K_m independent of j'; C and P are chosen after (J, m), matching C_{j,m}, P_{j,m}. Domain as in (9.17).
